items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps dry-looking skin comfortable without stripping.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to support the look of a smooth, well-moisturised skin barrier, since moisture reads low.
A gentle mineral SPF 50 for daily morning protection, which matters when skin is more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: I have left the facial wax strips out, because waxing can lift or tear skin that is fragile while on isotretinoin, so please ask your prescribing dermatologist what hair removal is safe for you. Cleanse gently morning and night, moisturise, and apply sunscreen every morning.
